name: Kaizuka Hidetaka
source:
Hidetaka is the husband of [url=https://vndb.org/c57229]Fumiko[/url] and the boss of [url=https://vndb.org/c57228]Kousuke[/url].

After the fire that burns down the Odaka couple's apartment, they decided to take them under their roof.
